tasks.instructions: Mount a hidden product-owned #golden-path-probe element in the renderer whose data-goldenpath-state plus step and reason detail is readable by the registered native replay, wired to the section-3 self-drive flow already proven in-process by rust-unit golden_path_section3_self_drive. The trigger must not fire on ordinary launches and the drive must mutate data only through the app's own APIs inside the replay's disposable profile. Expose focusboard:// activation state (cold argv and warm second-instance, token consumed exactly once, expired or reused token landing in the recoverable expired-link state) through the probe or an IPC query backed by the existing PendingDeepLink machinery so an out-of-process receipt can measure it. Preserve the baseline: all 27 existing IPC handlers, tsc --noEmit, vite build, cargo fmt --check, 16/16 rust-unit plus new unit tests for the probe state machine and deeplink reporting, the least-privilege capability file, and the app.focusboard.desktop identifier with the current module layout so host advisory recalibration stays possible; the two advisory white-box issues are host-owned calibration debt requiring no candidate change beyond that stability.
